policy.training: Normal_Insulators only; full images and all insulator GT boxes
policy.checkpoint_selection: best by normal validation detector fitness; last also retained
policy.split: Reuse existing identified-source-group split without resampling; path relocation verified by SHA256
policy.head: one-class insulator, not binary normal/defect detector

policy.frozen: modules0-4 parameters and BN, including P3 output; train modules5 onward
policy.voc: legacy continuous xyxy, no minus-one offset, clip derived labels only
policy.historical_reference: Old CPLID T1/T2 used different recipe and full fine-tuning; not a controlled matched comparison
